bugfix.report: user screenshot 2026-11-23 (macOS): dashboard replaced by error card 'Cannot access 'kt' before initialization'
bugfix.rootCause: 1.5.11 regression introduced by the rollover fix: DashboardPage declared `const todayKey = useDayKey(...)` ~160 lines AFTER the `range` useMemo whose dependency array reads todayKey. Deps arrays evaluate at first render, so the page crashed deterministically on mount on BOTH platforms ('kt' is the minified todayKey). Shipped because tsc does not check .jsx files and no test rendered DashboardPage.
bugfix.reproduction: built 1.5.11 dashboard/dist served statically and loaded in Chromium: exact error card reproduced; fixed bundle renders the full dashboard (sidebar, stats, heatmap, trend, daily breakdown) with no error card
bugfix.fix: moved the todayKey declaration above the range memo; also dropped .js specifiers on six TS-hook imports so vitest can resolve/transform the page at all
bugfix.regression: dashboard/src/pages/DashboardPage.render.test.jsx — verified to FAIL with the exact 'Cannot access 'todayKey' before initialization' ReferenceError on the broken ordering and pass on the fix
